projects.name: Byte Me
projects.description: A food delivery website, like Talabat. You pick a restaurant, put dishes in your cart, and place an order. Admins add restaurants and dishes and move orders along from "pending" to "completed".

projects.name: Legion
projects.description: A website for Legion, a made-up health company. It has six pages: home, platform, AI care agent, contact, sign in and create account.

projects.name: Pixel Verse Studios
projects.description: Pixel Verse Studios makes educational games and has a marketing website for them. Crab Quest: an ocean adventure that follows a crab through 6 chapters. Space X: an educational space shooter that teaches a fact about the solar system each time the game ends.

projects.name: MedMind
projects.description: A health-tech platform that closes the gap between "I don't feel well" and "I know what to do". A 24-hour chatbot gives a first read on symptoms, and the site lists doctors and hospitals (with prices and booking) and a library of diseases.

projects.name: Many Houses
projects.description: A web app that lets people browse property listings across Egypt, save their favorites, and prepare a contract draft, all in one place, instead of searching scattered Facebook groups and ads.

projects.name: NEO Challenge
projects.description: A free web app that puts three small daily habits in one place: sports challenges, language activities (English, French, German) and a general knowledge quiz, plus a workout library with 60 videos, a muscle explorer and nutrition plans.

projects.name: EmlakHub
projects.description: A real estate web app that makes it easy to search for properties and sell or rent them. Users browse the gallery, view each property's details, add a property after logging in, and prepare and download contracts.

projects.name: Ma'at
projects.description: An AI-powered web app that helps people understand Egyptian law. The user uploads a legal PDF (a law, a contract or a court ruling) and asks questions about it in Arabic or English; Google Gemini writes the answer.

projects.name: Vivestand
projects.description: A digital platform that connects injured athletes with the specialized sports products that match their injuries, and lets specialized merchants reach an interested audience.

projects.name: foodZILLA
projects.description: A healthy-eating web platform where users explore nutrient-dense recipes across 5 nutritional categories, follow step-by-step video tutorials with calorie tracking, and order balanced meals through a shopping cart, breaking the myth that healthy food is boring or hard to prepare.
projects.login_note: No login: the details form takes any password of 8+ characters. Recipe videos need internet (YouTube).

projects.name: Kido Care
projects.description: A website for pregnant women and new mothers. It explains pregnancy week by week and baby care month by month, and lets mothers book a doctor, ask a question, order vitamins and tick off vaccines and tests. Kido Bot answers common questions.

projects.name: Turbo
projects.description: A fast-paced traffic-safety educational game: the player drives through 6 road environments, dodges incoming traffic and collects coins to unlock custom cars, and learns a road sign and a safe-driving rule each time the game ends.
projects.login_note: No login. Press F in the game to switch to full screen.

projects.name: MedSync
projects.description: A web app that reminds patients to take their medicines and connects them with their care team. Doctors prescribe and follow adherence, nurses mark each dose as given or missed, patients get an alarm at each dose time, and a chatbot answers questions with Gemini.
projects.login_note: Choose the role Doctor when you log in.

projects.name: Eyad Store
projects.description: An online electronics shop. Visitors browse computers, phones, cameras and accessories, search and filter them, save favourites, fill a cart and check out. The cart and favourites are kept in the browser.
